title: CandidateRecord — owner-partitioned immutable sections for one payload candidate
description: Logical interfaces do not imply one standalone file each (plan §4): the fulfillment claim and the artifact manifest live as owner-partitioned immutable sections under one run root. The envelope is controller-generated identity and pointers; 'fulfillment' is authored solely by the executor; 'manifest' is authored solely by the deterministic diff verifier (V3-D5, N1-A7). The record lives in the control root E(C), OUTSIDE the payload candidate's own identity — payload and assurance evidence never share identity (V3-D9, N1-A5). Repair produces a new record for C2 with repair_round 1; a record is never edited in place.

repair_round.description: 0 = the original candidate C; 1 = the single user-approved repair candidate C2 (V3-D6, repair_cap 1).

candidate_ref.description: The exact isolated payload candidate this record speaks about.

base_revision.description: The exact base B the candidate was rooted at and the diff was taken against.

control_root.description: The control root E(C) holding this record and all other assurance evidence. No payload change may fall inside it: a control file written into the payload candidate collapses the payload/evidence identity separation (V3-D9, N1-A5).

authored_by.description: The executor. The executor authors claims about its own work and NOTHING else — it can never author a manifest, a CheckResult or a reviewer verdict (V3-D5).

claims.description: Exactly one claim per obligation — no more, no fewer (invariant 2). The join against the WorkSpec's obligation set is enforced outside this schema, which cannot see the WorkSpec.

fulfillmentPartition.description: Executor-owned partition: one implemented/not-implemented claim and exact candidate locators per obligation.

status.description: Closed claim set. NOT_IMPLEMENTED is explicit and can never be silently rendered as unqualified success (invariant 4).

implementation_locators.description: Where in the exact payload candidate the work landed. Required for IMPLEMENTED and forbidden for NOT_IMPLEMENTED; a claim is not evidence — each locator is separately checked for resolution against the candidate tree (invariant 3).

note.description: Required for NOT_IMPLEMENTED: the explicit reason the obligation was not implemented.

authored_by.description: The deterministic diff verifier — the SOLE author of this partition (V3-D5, N1-A7). It must not be the executor of the same run.

changes.description: Every actual add/modify/delete observed between the base and the candidate (invariant 5). Absent means the observed diff was empty — never an empty placeholder.

boundary_result.description: Whether the observed change set conforms to the effective change boundary. This is an ACCEPTANCE boundary result: it never asserts that the boundary prevented bytes from being written (V3-D3). Any out-of-boundary delta is NONCONFORMANT (invariant 6).

out_of_boundary_paths.description: Required when NONCONFORMANT: the exact observed paths that fell outside the effective boundary.

expected_artifact_results.description: Every expected artifact declared by the WorkSpec is either present in the candidate tree or explicitly missing — silence is not an option (invariant 7).

manifestPartition.description: Diff-verifier-owned partition: the actual observed change set, the boundary result and expected-artifact presence.

artifact_id.description: The WorkSpec's expected-artifact id. Its declared path is not copied here (N0-A6); presence was observed at that path in the candidate tree.
